description: This file defines the RequestException class within the GuzzleHttp library's exception namespace. It provides mechanisms to handle, wrap, and create detailed HTTP request-related exceptions, including factory methods for initializing exceptions based on response status and other contextual information.

classes.name: RequestException
classes.description: Represents exceptions related to HTTP requests within GuzzleHttp, providing facilities for wrapping, creating, and retrieving request/response data associated with errors.

methods.name: wrapException
methods.description: Wraps a generic Throwable into a RequestException, preserving the original exception if it's already a RequestException.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new RequestException with a detailed error message based on the response status code, request, and additional context.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the original HTTP request that caused the exception.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response associated with the exception, if available.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Checks if there is an associated response with the exception.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Returns the contextual information regarding the handler that encountered the error.
